situation: Dividing the chore: tidy the room

lines.speaker: A
lines.korean: 오늘 방 정리 누가 할 거야?
lines.romanization: oneul bang jeongni nuga hal geoya?
lines.meaning: Who is going to tidy the room today?

lines.speaker: A
lines.korean: 고마워. 그럼 나는 다른 거 할게.
lines.romanization: gomawo. geureom naneun dareun geo halge.
lines.meaning: Thanks. Then I will do something else.

teachingPoint: 내가 할게 is a natural casual way to volunteer.
